recent_news: Notion acquired Cron (calendar app) and Flowdash (work tracking software) in 2022, indicating expansion.
Notion launched its AI-based writing assistant in February 2023, with continuous expansions and integrations (e.g., GLM 5.2, Box AI Connector).
Notion crossed $500 million in annualized revenue and launched Notion AI Agent in September 2025.
Notion released version 3.0 with autonomous AI Agents and expanded MCP connectors in September 2025.
Notion bundled unlimited Notion AI usage into Business and Enterprise tiers in May 2025.
Notion introduced Notion Workers (hosted runtime for custom code) in July 2026.
No news of layoffs was found in the search results.
culture_signals: Notion fosters a collaborative culture where engineers provide feedback and input on technical specifications, avoiding isolated work.
The company highly values 'craft' in both its product and culture, emphasizing passion for making the product better and more intuitive.
Notion has a rigorous hiring process that includes thorough signals on candidates and strong emphasis on references as a predictor of success.
The company aims to be a lasting organization where employees can do their best and most meaningful work, finding fulfillment.

While Notion offers hybrid/remote options, particularly for security-related engineering roles, the remote work culture may not be as flexible as fully remote companies, with some employees noting a difference compared to previous employers.
